summary: Smoke tested Pousada Management System (pt-BR). Backend: auth (login/me/401), settings GET/PUT, public settings, rooms CRUD, public/rooms hides ical_token, admin reservations POST + PATCH status, public pre-reservation validates accepted_terms (400) and creates status=pending source=public_form on valid submit, iCal export (valid VEVENT) + 403 on wrong token, iCal sources with unreachable URL captures error in sync response, WhatsApp templates auto-seeded (4 defaults), finance income create + summary with occupancy. Frontend: public site (/) renders pousada info + Reservar CTA, /reservar FNRH form validates terms and shows success screen, /admin/login authenticates and redirects to /admin, all sidebar nav items render (Reservas page shows filter and Nova Reserva button).
passed: POST /api/rooms creates room with ical_token; GET /api/public/rooms hides ical_token
POST /api/public/pre-reservation: 400 when accepted_terms=false; success with status=pending source=public_form when true
GET /api/ical/room/{room_id}/{token}.ics returns text/calendar with VEVENT; 403 on wrong token
POST /api/ical/sources creates source; sync captures error on unreachable URL
POST /api/finance (kind=income) creates entry; GET /api/finance/summary returns income/expense/profit/occupancy
Public site (/) loads: hero, description, gallery, contact, PIX, WhatsApp link visible
/reservar FNRH form: submit without terms shows 'Aceite os termos...'; valid submit shows 'Pré-reserva enviada!' success screen
Admin sidebar navigation (Calendário, Reservas, Quartos, iCal, WhatsApp, Financeiro, Conta) renders and Reservas page shows filter and 'Nova Reserva' button
notes: Backend field naming: public pre-reservation uses 'guest_birthdate' (not guest_birth_date) and finance uses 'kind'/'entry_date' (not type/date). Endpoints work correctly with those names.
Sidebar 'Site & Galeria' nav uses data-testid='nav-settings' (not nav-site as mentioned in review). Not a bug; frontend/testids are consistent internally.
Admin password was NOT changed during testing, so no revert needed. change-password endpoint not exercised to avoid risk.
